attribution.supervisor: Codex traced the dependencies required by the amplitude expansion and adapted the flag-measure, lattice and cardinality proofs.
attribution.finiteness_analysis: Selected the finite-orbits component and seven direct dependencies and measured the three unused editable modules in the accepted parent.
attribution.source_implementation: Codex adapted the consumer, extracted the original three finite-set lemmas and replaced the conjunction projection with its finite-orbits component.
attribution.supervisor_amplitude_reduction: Codex specialized the internal product theorem to the amplitude identity and removed its unused real nonnegative mass identity. The original challenge theorem and the local support and finiteness arguments are retained.
attribution.supervisor_orbit_reduction: Codex proved the term criterion and the complex summand equality directly on the chosen orbit representative, using stabilizer invariance of the weights and predicate. This removes the helper proving both a mass and an amplitude statement.
attribution.supervisor_class_finiteness: Codex covered the integral frame-class orbits by the finite image of normalized unipotent representatives. This replaces the weighted class-count proof and its total-weight bound. The earlier finite-fibre and finite-orbit lemmas are preserved.
attribution.supervisor_good_places: Codex computed the unique good-place term weight from equality of the term and frame stabilizer, and specialized the good-place theorem to the two statements needed by the amplitude expansion. The coordinate height follows directly from the zero exponents.
